fusions.name: Deadweight Stoop
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 7 tiles away and lands on it for 12 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Pinion Scatter
fusions.desc: Looses 3 metal pinions at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage, with a 30% chance per hit to leave the target [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Alight Braced
fusions.desc: Hops you 3 tiles from where you stood, and raises your armour by 20% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Hollow-Forged Bones
fusions.desc: You move 8% faster, and your physical resistance rises by 6%.
